Description

These giants are slightly larger than the thunder gigas with darker skin. These giants can wield aero magic and fly.

Defense

AC 32, touch 11, flat-footed 29 (+8 armor, +3 dex, +13 natural, -2 size)

hp 230 [300] (20d8+140)

mp 22

Fort +19, Ref +9, Will +11

Defensive Abilities Rock Catching

Immune Wind

Resist Earth 25+50%

Weakness Lightning

Offense

Speed 50 ft., fly 100 ft. (average), (35 ft., fly 80 ft. in armor)

Melee +2 Greatsword +30/+25/+20 (4d6+24/17-20) or 2 Slams +28 (2d6+15)

Ranged +2 Composite Longbow +18/+13/+8 (3d6+17/x3)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.

Special Attacks Magnitude 8

Spells Known (PC CL 21st, Concentration +24)

Constant - Fly

1st (DC 16) - Aero

2nd (DC 17) - Aero II, Blur, Grace, Temper, Wind Barrier

3rd (DC 18) - Aera, Aero III, Haste

Statistics

Str 40, Dex 16, Con 24, Int 16, Wis 20, Cha 16

Base Atk +15; CMB +32; CMD 45

Feats Awesome Blow, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (greatsword), Improved Initiative, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, Vital Strike

Skills Acrobatics +20, Climb +19, Intimidate +22, Perception +29, Sense Motive +26

Languages Auran, Common, Draconic, Giant

SQ Militant, Water Breathing

Combat Gear breastplate +2, composite longbow +2 with 20 arrows, greatsword +2

description.value: Breathes normally underwater.
Once per round, Reflex DC 15/20/25 to catch a Small/Medium/Large rock.

Normally, armor heavier than light armor interferes with a spell-caster gestures, which can cause spells to fail if those spells have a somatic component. An elm gigas's limited focus and specialized training, however, allows him to avoid spell failure so long as he sticks to medium armor or light armor.

Once every 1d4 rounds and must be within reach of the ground, an elm gigas can cause the ground to erupt wildly around it within a 60-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 15d10 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the weighted status effect for 1d8 rounds. They must make Reflex save (DC 25) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 31).
